assessments.reasoning: The cited exhaustiveness list gives both Boolean constants as a separate sufficient alternative to an else branch when a Boolean value is bound. Other applicable conditions use equality to that subject.

The introduction is applicable context for the Kotlin/Core scope and historical experimental status. The expressions chapter independently supplies the Boolean rule; no claim of platform equivalence follows.

challenge.method: Compare bound and subjectless cases, both constant values, nullable subject handling, and the introductory limit on platform applicability.
challenge.results: Both constants suffice for an otherwise legal when with a non-null Boolean subject. Mere general Boolean predicates, nullable coverage and subjectless exhaustion remain separate.

limitations: Nullable Boolean, subjectless conditions, sealed hierarchies and special equality behavior follow separate rules.
The experimental RFC describes scoped Kotlin/Core behavior at the pinned release.
